anchor.exact: Tandem Comments stores JSON in a fenced block at the end of each Markdown note. That makes comments portable, but it also changes the note, produces document diffs for review-only activity, and exposes the raw block when the plugin is unavailable.

body: Tandem Comments 와 Anchored Comments 에 영감을 받았다로 짧게 수정 가능할까?

anchor.exact: Sideband Comments is inspired by Tandem Comments and Anchored Comments.
